ValidationRule.description: Checks whether Rebill Invoice Number is blank or not
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName != 'CustomerService', NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c),NOT(CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'Digital Hub' )), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c , 'Invoice Adjustments'), AND(OR(ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closed'),ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closure Pending')), OR(PMC_SS_RebillAmount__c = 0, ISBLANK( PMC_SS_RebillAmount__c ))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Rebill Amount cannot be blank or 0
